narration: Lars's birthday money is gone. At home, he watches his big brother Senna count his money. Senna earned it walking dogs in the neighborhood. "It's a great way to make some money," Senna says.
image_brief: Lars sitting on the edge of a bed, watching his big brother Senna count dog-walking money into a jar at home.

narration: Lars kept his $5 safe today. That night, he thinks about Senna's dog walking. He decides to start his own business: a lemonade stand!
image_brief: Lars at his desk at night, drawing a lemonade stand in his notebook, a $5 bill beside him.

narration: Senna loves his new phone case. That night, Lars tells Mom his big dream: swapping his old bike for a better mountain bike. Mom says she'll help, but Lars has to pay for part of it himself. Pocket money won't get him there, so Lars makes a plan: a lemonade stand!
image_brief: Lars and Mom talking at the kitchen table in the evening, Lars excited, a picture of a mountain bike in his mind.

narration: First he needs a jug, paper cups, lemons and sugar. That costs money too, so he decides to save for it. Mom agrees, as long as the stand goes by their front gate, where she can see him.
image_brief: Lars writing his startup list (jug, cups, lemons, sugar) while Mom reads over his shoulder, smiling.

narration: Lars finds an old jam jar and writes 'Emergencies' on the lid. It's only a jar, but it's a start. Every time he gets money, some goes in. Next time something breaks, he'll be ready.
image_brief: Lars at his desk, writing 'Emergencies' on the lid of an old jam jar, a few coins beside it.

narration: The headphones are replaced, but Lars's startup money is still $0. "Before you buy something, ask if you really want or need it," says his school friend Mason. "That's how I've saved so much."
image_brief: Lars and his school friend Mason eating lunch in the school yard, Mason giving advice with a calm shrug.

narration: Lars grabs an envelope to keep his stand money separate. He writes 'Startup money needed: $15' on the front.
image_brief: Lars at his desk writing 'Startup money needed: $15' on an envelope, coins stacked beside it.

narration: He tucks the envelope away. $10 saved, $5 to go. He pictures his stand by the front gate, with a bright sign and a jug of lemonade.
image_brief: Lars tucking the envelope into a drawer, with a dreamy thought bubble of his lemonade stand by the front gate.

narration: Lars and Mia share the birthday gelato, one spoonful each. His startup envelope still holds $10.
image_brief: Lars and Mia leaving the gelato shop, sharing one gelato with two spoons, Mia in a birthday badge.

narration: Lars paid his own half. No borrowing, no stress. His startup money stayed at $10, and he still has $3 spare.
image_brief: Lars and Mia waiting in line at the movie theater, tickets in hand, Lars looking relaxed.

narration: While they wait, Mia doodles a lemon on her ticket. "I could design the sign for your stand," she says.
image_brief: Close-up of Mia doodling a lemon on her movie ticket while Lars grins.

narration: At the bus stop, Lars tells Mason his big news. Mom told the neighbors, and lots of them want to buy lemonade!
image_brief: Lars and Mason at the school bus stop, Lars excitedly sharing his news, Mason listening.

narration: Two straws, one slushie, and $1 still in Lars's pocket. "Deals like that used to get me every time," Lars laughs.
image_brief: Lars and Mia sharing one slushie with two straws, Lars laughing.

narration: Saturday morning. Lars looks at the note above his desk: 'Mountain bike'. His startup envelope stays at home. Today's money is just for the mall.
image_brief: Lars at his desk on a sunny morning, looking at a note on his wall that says 'Mountain bike'.

narration: But today he's going to the mall with his friends. What he does with his money today is up to you!
image_brief: Lars heading out the front door with a small wallet, waving to Mom.

narration: With $15 in his envelope, Lars buys a jug, cups, lemons and sugar. Mia's sign goes on the front. On Saturday, his stand opens by the front gate.
image_brief: Lars at his new lemonade stand by the front gate, Mia's sign on the front, Mom watching from the porch.

narration: He's one step closer to his mountain bike!
image_brief: Lars behind his stand, proudly holding up a cup of lemonade.
